item.title: FIXED: Host Migration, EAC issue + Vehicle Balance & Ork Hedz Wallpaper
item.description:
WE'Z DUN SUM FINGS
Networking fixes and more

Check out the latest patch changelist below:

  • Fixed Host Migration not working sometimes

  • Fixed Easy Anti-Cheat error issue

  • Fixed issue with player stats not calculating properly at the end of a match

  • Hopefully fixed issue with some new players having a greyed out menu

  • Possible fix for not being able to quit the game from the ingame menu

  • Reworked team balancing to be more stable

  • General networking stability improved

  • Workshop backend futureproofing (let us know if you experience issues)

  • Fixed analog stick drift affecting camera navigation in Creation Mode

  • VEHICLE BALANCE

    • Deffkopta health increased from 95 to 100

    • Shokkjump Dragsta health decreased from 140 to 130

    • Shokkjump Dragsta Unstable Shokk Rifle damage increased from 9 to 9.5 per burst

    • Trukk now accelerates more quickly

YOU'Z LIKE ORKZ, DO YA'Z?!

Well, we'z got a snazzy 4k Wallpaper fer ya'z den called BONK

(this wallpaper was from a piece of key art created last year that was never used)

Link to the 4k wallpaper is -HERE-

Hope ya like it! (and the patch)

As always, if you want to meet gits and krump togetha, join the official Speed Freeks Discord

item.title: Hotfix 1.6.1.514 is live!
item.description:
Lord Captains, hotfix 1.6.1.514 is live!

We've fixed a few annoying bugs often reported by the community:

  • Fixed the epilogues abruptly ending in a few cases for the heretical conviction if certain choices were made;
  • Glaito will no longer sometimes disappear after the Vheabos-VI mission;
  • Fixed a loud weapon firing sound that sometimes could persist after cutscenes in the Infinite Museion;
  • Using Furious Assault with Ogryn Grip sometimes led to the character being stuck in animation, not ending their turn - fixed.

Note that https://steamcommunity.com/app/2186680/discussions/0/4027970580228219058/ always contains up-to-date information on known issues and the roadmap of upcoming patches.

As usual, it may take up to 48 hours for this update to appear on consoles.

item.title: Hotfix 8.1.1
item.description:
Hey folks,

Hotfix 8.1.1 has just rolled out for Total War: WARHAMMER III, focused on implementing the following quick fixes in the wake of Patch 8.1:

  • Fixed potential crash on boot that was affecting some players.

  • Reverted unintended change where Shadow Walkers’ weapons could stack multiple contact effects.

  • Fixed issue with screen scrolling when using the mouse cursor to scroll. Note: we are aware of some specific instances where this may still occur and are investigating further.

As always, if you run into any news issues after updating to 8.1.1, please report them in our dedicated bug reporting sub-forum.

See you on the battlefield!

— Steve // Senior Community Manager

⚠ IMPORTANT

If you experience any issues after downloading the update, please take a moment to Verify the integrity of the game files first to ensure there were no issues when downloading. A step-by-step guide can be found in this article.

If the issues persist, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

🧱 MOD WARNING

Please note that user-generated mods may have compatibility issues with new game updates. If you are encountering performance or stability issues following a release, is recommended that you disable any mods you're running. If you continue to experience issues, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

For the latest news and announcements, drop by our official social channels.

SteamXFacebookInstagramDiscordBluesky

item.title: Update 1.6.1.511 is live!
item.description:
Lord Captains, Update 1.6.1.511 is live!

In it, we're fixing the annoying bug with Blade Dancer and Assassin abilities, a lot of narrative and epilogue fixes, additional reactivity for Eogunn, enemies becoming immune to attack during the first turn of combat, and more.

Note that https://steamcommunity.com/app/2186680/discussions/0/4027970580228219058/ always contains up-to-date information on known issues and the roadmap of upcoming patches.

As usual, it may take up to 48 hours for this update to appear on consoles.

Please be aware of the plot spoilers below!

Patch Notes

Narrative

  • Epilogues related to Malice, Abel, the Commissar, Achilleas and Clementia were displaying incorrect portraits - fixed;
  • Leaving some companions in the Bottomless Pit lacked an epilogue - fixed;
  • Fixed an issue causing multiple Zarkov-related epilogues to not be displayed;
  • Epilogues related to Tirkuaz-4 were not displayed if a certain choice was made - fixed;
  • Epilogues related to Nuncius were not displayed if a certain choice was made - fixed;
  • Added missing background images to some epilogues;
  • Some DLC3 companion banter had incorrect conditions and never popped up - fixed;
  • Eogunn will no longer sometimes insert his comments that were meant for another conversation;
  • Eogunn's options were not correctly displayed in Zarkov Chronicles 1 and 3 - fixed;
  • Fixed a bug which made it possible to repeatedly call Solomorne to the bath, causing his dialogue to break and equipment to disappear;
  • Added additional reactivity for Eogunn to several key places, including Pasqal's second quest and Tirkuaz-4;
  • Fixed Seberian still appearing on the voidship bridge after being given away;
  • Added subtitles on all languages for the Hymn of the Lost at Zarkov;
  • Improved the dialogue with the Deathwatch Captain and added additional Ulfar and Eogunn reactivity for it;
  • Fixed some missing character banter on Marazhai's quest;
  • Self surgery event will no longer appear if we already know truth about Nuncius;
  • Vedka and Janur will no longer die in the battle with the Drover;
  • Added additional clarifying objectives and quest markers to multiple The Infinite Museion DLC quests;
  • Added an option to give the core to the Adeptus Mechanicus after the return from Tirkuaz-4;
  • Reworded an errand about waiting for the end of Zarkov excavation for better clarity and understanding how long the player needs to wait;
  • Abelard will now make his comments regarding the Krieg soldiers in time, not a few encounters later - your trusted Senechal is not THAT old yet;
  • Fixed a broken dialogue with Marazhai, Heinrix and Yrliet at the Spire;

Yrliet

  • Fixed a bug causing the bath cutscene with Yrliet to have a long odd pause in the beginning;

Mechanics

  • The Death from Above and Blade Dance ability didn't work with Scourging Strikes talent and Where It Hurts Ability - fixed;
  • Assassin's talent Imminent Demise now properly scales damage from attacks;
  • Clenched Teeth was sometimes not working - fixed;
  • Fixed a bug causing enemy reinforcements that arrive during combat to become immune to single target damage until they make at least one turn;
  • Killing Trazyn while he is under effect of Lord of Histories no longer breaks the fight;
  • Commorragh debuff will be now correctly removed from Pasqal if the xeno augmentation was removed;
  • Fixed a bug during the battle with Chronomancer which could cause Zorael to stay in combat forever if the Chronomancer was killed before his arrival;
  • The augmentation screen is no longer available during the Heartless Arbites scenario and Kibellah's search at the Lower Decks;
  • Trazyn will no longer use Mindshackle scarabs on the Rogue Trader;
  • Assassin's talent Imminent Demise now properly scales damage from attacks;
  • Captain Walz sometimes refused to die, locking the combat - fixed;

Items

  • Malpian Shroud will no longer deal an additional instance of massive base damage when used with Kick or Slice;
  • in some rare cases consumables (grenades, medkits) could not be equipped onto a companion - fixed;

UI

  • Fixed a few issues with formula display for abilities;
  • Genetor Ferrenz and Vivisector Martinax were sometimes displayed on the map despite not being there - fixed;


Visuals

  • Eogunn's body will no longer disappear after installing certain augments;
  • Improved some cutscenes at the Cage;
  • Improved Seberian's soldiers animations at Zarkov;
  • Improved the Krieg battle cutscene;
  • Lasguns were sometimes losing textures after the wielder's death - fixed;

Audio

  • Fixed Level-up window missing some sounds.

Miscellaneous

  • The Infinite Museion achievement will no longer require keeping Seberian alive;
  • Kill the Xenos! achievement had a typo in its code that caused it to never pop up - fixed;

item.title: The Infinite Museion and Update 1.6 Community Survey
item.description:
Lord Captain!

You've delved into Trazyn's vault, explored The Infinite Museion, and met the big Update 1.6 head-on — we'd love to hear your impressions!

We've launched a new community survey covering the DLC and Update 1.6.

It takes about 20 minutes, and there are no wrong answers here — only your honest perspective, which we read closely and value greatly as we shape what comes next for Rogue Trader.

Take the survey: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/P5RM77D
